original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can scripts/audit_joint_frames.py product be sped up for the historical positive-side audit (scripts/audit_positive_side.py on the six (h,q) experiment pairs) without changing any experiment receipt field, dag_sha256, invocation/frame evidence, or any certificate except the single audit_joint_frames.py source pin in certificates/rank-product-core.json?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. The OS-random recursive-interfaces draw (seed 560ea64f08df0bb946b45c68558f678e) landed on coverage-law / connector / centre-share cards that are saturated or deferred (centre-share, line-port). Expertise override selected verifier-engineering (seed 79c3cf58a04ab05b039e968bb04812a5). Profiling named audit_joint_frames.product inside positive_side_core.verify_frames / rank_product_core.check_core as the bottleneck on this fixed historical screen.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: positive-side and rank-product certificates are part of verify-certificates. A faster identical replay does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving product change with frozen baseline, identical positive-side experiment receipts, pin discipline on the one binding certificate, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not reopen the mathematical obstruction or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_JOINT_FRAMES_CLEARED_PRODUCT via research/joint-frames-cleared-product/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_POSITIVE_SIDE_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/rank-product-core.json differs from base only in the audit_joint_frames.py source pin.
